_note: RoomIQ's claim rules, from the go-to-market (Saasrelaunchdev/roomIQGTMBuild GTM-BRIEF.md Section 5, the do-not-write table and the banned list; deliverables/scorecard_spec.docx Section 5) and the production landing page's non-negotiables. Applied to every visitor-facing word in content/ by tools/copy-lint.mjs on each build and in npm test. refusalOk: the words may appear only in a sentence that refuses them (no, not, never, don't, isn't...). allow: a content key (a prefix match) where a rule is waived, with the reason. budgets: word budgets; the hero-quiz variant's h1 and lead are errors over budget, everything else a warning. Always on: no em or en dashes, and a percentage needs its source in the same sentence.

rules.msg: No accuracy claim before the 90-day backtest: say the estimate shows its working (decision 8)

rules.re: \b(cash-?flowing deals?|passive income|guaranteed (income|returns?|rent)|(high|higher|better|bigger) returns?|boost (your )?(cash|returns?|income|rent)|how much (you|your house|it) (could|will|can) (earn|make)|you('ll| will) (earn|make))\b
rules.msg: No income, return or yield promise; the deal math is informational, not financial or lending advice
No return, yield or cash-on-cash figure
Write 'markets ranked by RoomIQ's Market Score', never 'the best markets to invest in'
It is observed listing data: 'observed rents and occupancy, not collected payments'
No named platform, data source or competitor: categories only
No price comparison: publish the plans as they are
No time-saved figure: nobody has timed the product flow
No price, trial or term in the funnel: the next step is the Free plan

rules.re: \b(zoning check|compliance check|you('re| are) compliant|insurance-ready|flood risk assessment|legal advice|lending advice|financial advice)\b
rules.msg: RoomIQ makes no zoning, compliance, insurance or flood determination and gives no advice

rules.re: \b(you should buy|buy this house|safe investment|risk-free|can't lose|sure thing)\b
rules.msg: Nothing that reads as investment advice
